provider.measure: Injected public TextMetrics object/Mapping; no private Canvas/font constructor.
provider.content_layout: markup,style,width -> width,height,lines,runs. Parent opacity/filter/background are cleared from child base, child visibility retained.
provider.asset_loader: id,image,attributes,style,False -> width,height; explicit original resource_id retained.
provider.coordinates: CSS px, control-local, text baseline y, circle bbox, line delta, path local coords. Margins included in dimensions and baseline; all paints offset once.
provider.clipping: Text/image/body runs only; fieldset caption runs and outer chrome not clipped.
provider.uaStyle: Caller applies low-priority control_ua_style(tag,parent,disabled=...), then author CSS; layout consumes resolved result.
provider.css: CONTROL_CSS_PROPERTIES exported; split_control_style returns two CSS strings; parse_control_declarations returns name,value,important tuples.

nativeHostAdaptation: Mermaid delegates all control rendering to browser UA. This pure native host expresses initial static control semantics using public metrics. Default colors/shapes/ratios are native UA intent, not a literal Mermaid algorithm or browser pixel-coordinate transplant.
explicitLimits: Complex CSS calc()/min()/max()/clamp() and non-solid control box background resources are explicitly unsupported, not silently ignored.
Per-corner/elliptical border radii and arbitrary CSS layout systems are outside this control-local box implementation.
Contextual vertical-align top/bottom/middle/text-top/text-bottom requires shared line-layout placement; numeric/sub/super offsets are represented through baseline.
Date/time UI locale/picker surface, platform file chooser wording and exact UA pixel appearance are host-dependent; no interaction/picker/scroll action is implemented.
Emergency text wrapping preserves combining/variation/ZWJ groups, but is not a standalone Unicode bidi/grapheme/shaping engine; actual text shaping remains the injected Canvas provider.
p2HostQuestions: Default UA font inheritance and dimensions for each type versus source browser, across explicit font/line-height and disabled author-color overrides.
Initial select list viewport and optgroup sizing with selected items beyond the first window.
Textarea soft/hard/off wrapping, whitespace, combining text, visible initial overflow and resize mark.
Date/time empty and valid values, RTL value/hint alignment, image single-axis dimensions/aspect and zero sizes.
Meter region thresholds/optimum boundary inclusivity, progress indeterminate static visibility.
CSS box sizing/shorthand important ordering, percentages with finite/indefinite containing widths, visibility descendants and fieldset legend frame.

changes: Consume border-top-width/style/color canonical longhand keys after shorthand expansion.
Source UA default box-sizing differs by control family; date/time inputs use monospace; display does not inherit parent block.
Radio checked state is a white outer disk with accent center, not an accent disk with white center.
All direct text paints and plain caption runs retain spacing, text shadows and text-stroke axes.
input image calls shared control-image natural-size protocol rather than ordinary configurable label-image protocol.
